item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Eating. Your day's got a real shape to it — check-ins, movement, some quiet time built in. That structure only helps if meals happen inside it, not around it. Don't let a packed schedule push food to the edges or turn it into an afterthought grabbed between tasks. Pick one meal today and actually sit down for it, no multitasking. That's the action.
